title: Phase 3 Pre-Flight Check: Topology, Weave, FAIR Risk & Audit Vocabulary Audit
role_boundary: audit and pre-flight verification only; no Phase 3 production deliverables modified

surface_4_topology_audit.dagre_dependency_requirement: P3-1 must add @dagrejs/dagre (or dagre / @types/dagre) to package.json AND update package-lock.json via 'npm install --package-lock-only' to satisfy lockfileSync.test.ts and prevent container build failures
surface_4_topology_audit.rendering_engine: ReactFlow v12 SVG/HTML custom nodes compatible with jsdom and headless test environments

topology_backend_drop_sites.behavior: Drops nodes and edges where node.tenant != authenticated_tenant and node.tenant is not None; drops edges referencing dropped nodes
When TRUST_TOPOLOGY_URL collector is unreachable, synthesizes _derived_topology containing only platform root, tenant node, and registered/enrolled agents, omitting cluster-level infrastructure nodes
Filters by plane (identity, authorization, network), decision (allowed, denied, modeled), location (in-cluster, external), and evidence state

serialization_model.nodes_model: TrustTopologyItem (id, kind, label, tenant, parent_id, location, evidence_state, evidence_source, observed_at, freshness, assurance, reason)
serialization_model.edges_model: TrustTopologyEdge (id, from_id, to_id, verb, plane, decision, tenant, evidence_state, evidence_source, observed_at, freshness, assurance, reason)

rename_targets: Documentation and test fixtures referencing Activity
surface_5_weave_audit.baseline_suite: make test-dashboard-weave passes with 84/84 tests across 4 test files

hooks: useAgentRisk(agentId) - fetches per-agent risk with monotonic run sequencing, AbortSignal cancellation, and error trapping
useFleetRisk(enabled) - fetches fleet risk rollup with identical race protection
current_defects_and_gaps: RiskExposurePage.tsx lines 189-191 scale static/empty exposure values (totalAle=0, totalVar95=0)
RiskExposurePage.tsx hardcodes VERSIONS array instead of querying framework catalog API
surface_6_fair_risk_audit.p3_3_target_plan: Implement population filter (Governed, Discovered, All), dynamic version fetching from API, dynamic ale/var95 calculation via fairApi.ts/useAgentRisk.ts, and reactive recalculation under 250ms

columns: timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
surface_10_audit_trail_audit.append_only_trigger: audit_events_append_only (migration 030) enforces append-only semantics, rejecting UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE

unmapped_filter_vocabulary.test_guard: tests/test_dashboard_audit_vocabulary.py verifies 1:1 agreement between emitted events, legacy filter list, and AuditTrail.tsx EVENT_TYPES/EVENT_COLORS

surface_10_audit_trail_audit.p3_4_target_plan: Convert AuditTrail.tsx detail cell (:865) from one-line JSON.stringify to clickable/keyboard trigger opening syntax-highlighted JSON drawer with SPIFFE ID, attestation hashes, actor provenance, and copy button

preflight_verdict.summary: Phase 3 pre-flight verification fully certified. Baseline test suites green (Weave 84/84 tests across 4 files, dashboard Vitest 3,499/3,502 tests across 195 files, Policy Engine Go 4/4 packages, TypeScript typecheck 0 errors). Dependencies, proxy architectures, topology drop sites, and audit vocabulary inventory cataloged. Phase 3 tasks (SLMS-P3-1, SLMS-P3-2, SLMS-P3-3, SLMS-P3-4) unblocked.
